title: Technical architecture scan
description: Inspect current authoritative runtime path, app shell, Tauri host, gateway endpoints, and user-facing surfaces.
findings: Authoritative runtime is desktop + src-ts with Tauri-managed gateway. App shell fans out to knowledge, settings, evaluation, MCP status, writing helper, text optimizer, editor, and chat surfaces.

title: Delivery and release status
description: Inspect release authority files, CI gates, local release summary output, and representative tests.
findings: Local release summary generated on 2026-04-07 reports GO with all blocking checks PASS, including phase4 coverage baseline, desktop check, sidecar readiness, external smoke, production guard, and metrics guard.

title: Migration and debt status
description: Inspect Python-to-TypeScript transition evidence, compatibility paths, deprecated web UI, and dual runtime handling.
findings: Repository is Node-first in runtime and packaging authority, but still carries explicit Python compatibility and deprecated web/Streamlit paths. Main debt is mixed-runtime complexity rather than missing primary-path functionality.

title: Project status synthesis
description: Integrate technical, delivery, and migration findings into current-state assessment.
findings: Project appears release-ready on its current authoritative path, with a working desktop-plus-gateway architecture and active CI evidence. Remaining risk is governance and complexity around retained compatibility layers and soft gates, not core-path breakage.
